verdict.rationale: The Texas Comptroller is a government tax authority whose filing and payment portal (Webfile/eSystems) and read-only open-data datasets do not host user-defined automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any automation feature that would make the axis apply. Post-dating a single payment is a one-off scheduling option, not a versioned or recurring automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
